Official Odd Town AI thread: What was missed and how we’re fixing it
TL;DR

Odd Town has some AI supported content (some dialogues in the early part of the game). We are sorry we missed this. We are working to rewrite these parts and update the game ASAP, and we will make sure to do much better in the future!

Some background

In the early stages of development Flying Baguette, the solo developer behind the game, had experimented with AI to be able to self publish Odd Town if he could not find support with the full game release.

The first thing we did together when we started our collaboration was to get rid of it. All the generated art (posters and graffiti) was replaced by our art team well in advance of the release (in the demo as well).

What happened

We realized we had unfortunately missed replacing the affected dialogue. Flying Baguette had used an LLM to help him with some of these dialogues in the Odd Town demo as English isn't his first language.

Not nearly all of the demo dialogue used LLM support (as someone pointed out, there’s even a spelling mistake in a trailer).

The rest of the game doesn’t use any generated content. We can say this both on the word of the developer, and also on our own judgment, as the dialogue we worked with for the full version had plenty of common slips. Our QA team and independent proofreaders can attest to this.

What’s next

We are now working on replacing the lines that used LLM support with original content. Flying Baguette is checking his work (this dialogue was written over two years ago), our QA team is going through the script focusing on identifying the generated remnants, and we have commissioned an independent editor to support us.

That being said, please accept our sincere apology for the whole situation. In the meantime we have disclosed the use of AI on the Odd Town Steam store page and want to reassure you that, across all the titles we publish and develop, what we value the most is authorship and craft. We will do better.

We will update you on the improvements as soon as changes are done.
